fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya published in December 2024 an analytical fact sheet of ICT uptake from the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey.
The Communications Authority and KNBS released an analytical report on ICT uptake based on the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey, covering 42,022 households in 1,692 clusters.

KNBS's director general said on 31 January 2025, after a court cancelled the 2019 census results for parts of Wajir, Mandera and Garissa, that groundwork had been laid for the 2029 census, Kenya's seventh.
